nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the IAPGuard backend application.

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: Provides SQLite connection management, schema initialization, bulk transaction insertion, and row conversion helpers.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: Defines the FastAPI application lifecycle, synthetic-data seeding, model operations, transaction APIs, review workflow, and evaluation endpoint.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Implements feature extraction, a PyTorch variational autoencoder, calibration thresholds, scoring, residual explanations, and local model persistence.

nodes.name: synthetic.py
nodes.summary: Generates reproducible synthetic fitness-app purchase records with normal behavior and injected anomaly patterns.

nodes.name: pytest.ini
nodes.summary: Configures pytest to use the backend directory as the import root and tests directory.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pins the backend runtime, web framework, numerical, machine-learning, and test dependencies to compatible major-version ranges.

nodes.name: test_api.py
nodes.summary: Runs an end-to-end FastAPI TestClient scenario covering startup, dashboard data, filtering, detail inspection, reviews, analysis, evaluation, model state, and not-found handling.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Minimal Vite HTML entry point that mounts the React dashboard root and loads the JSX module.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Declares the React dashboard scripts and dependencies, including Vite, Lucide icons, and Recharts.

nodes.name: api.js
nodes.summary: Provides the frontend HTTP client wrapper for backend API requests plus currency, number, and date formatters.

nodes.name: main.jsx
nodes.summary: Implements the React single-page fraud intelligence dashboard, navigation, overview charts, transaction explorer, alert queue, detection lab, model page, and review drawer.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Defines the dark responsive dashboard visual system, cards, tables, forms, charts, modal drawer, status badges, and mobile layouts.

nodes.name: vite.config.js
nodes.summary: Configures Vite with the React plugin, development host and port, and a proxy from frontend API calls to the FastAPI server.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Context manager that opens SQLite, commits successful work, rolls back failures, and closes the connection.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Creates the transactions and reviews tables and their query indexes when the service starts.

nodes.name: insert_many
nodes.summary: Bulk-inserts transaction dictionaries using the fixed transaction column set and parameterized SQL.

nodes.name: features
nodes.summary: Transforms a transaction into the eleven normalized model input features, including logarithmic, cyclical, and categorical values.

nodes.name: VAE
nodes.summary: PyTorch variational autoencoder with encoder, latent mean and variance, stochastic training path, and decoder.

nodes.name: Detector
nodes.summary: Owns VAE training, held-out percentile calibration, anomaly scoring, top residual ranking, and trusted local checkpoint loading/saving.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Creates seeded transaction records and injects one of four illustrative fraud behavior patterns for labeled evaluation.

nodes.name: app
nodes.summary: FastAPI application configured with lifespan initialization, CORS for local dashboard origins, and API routes.

nodes.name: TransactionInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model validating transaction features submitted to the analysis endpoint.

nodes.name: ReviewInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model restricting review decisions and note length for transaction investigations.

nodes.name: seed_demo
nodes.summary: Trains on normal synthetic records, inserts an independently generated evaluation set, and rescored persisted transactions.

nodes.name: rescore_all
nodes.summary: Scores every persisted transaction under the model lock and updates anomaly scores and risk levels.

nodes.name: test_end_to_end
nodes.summary: Exercises the principal backend API lifecycle and verifies expected response shapes and status codes.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root React component managing page navigation, shared data loading, refresh actions, notifications, and transaction detail state.

nodes.name: Overview
nodes.summary: Renders dashboard metrics, daily transaction activity, risk distribution, and recent transactions.

nodes.name: Transactions
nodes.summary: Renders searchable and risk-filtered transaction pages with pagination and CSV export.

nodes.name: Lab
nodes.summary: Collects transaction features and submits them to the analysis endpoint, displaying risk, thresholds, and top deviations.

nodes.name: Detail
nodes.summary: Displays transaction investigation details and submits a human review decision and notes.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Fetches JSON from the backend API, converts HTTP failures into user-facing errors, and supports configurable API base URLs.
